class.name: hubot_live_stack::FullWindowBoundsLayer
class.description: Declares the full rolling window as the costmap update bounds and writes no costs. Required because CostmapFilter::updateBounds() ignores the bounds arguments, so with no bounds-declaring plugin LayeredCostmap's `if (xn >= x0 && yn >= y0)` guard is never satisfied and no filter is ever driven.
